Paths vary by One UI version. Exact menu labels should be verified on your S24 Ultra before sharing with others.
GymMonth counts gym visits this calendar month from Health Connect strength and gym-like workouts. Totals stay on this phone. No data is uploaded.

We request read access to:
• Exercise sessions (to find strength / gym workouts)
• Background read (optional, for the home-screen widget)

We never write workouts and do not request health history beyond the platform default window. Distance is not required for visit counts.
GymMonth does not use the network in v1. Derived monthly visit totals are stored only on device and excluded from backup.
